fields.notes: CAN 2.0 is a wire-level protocol spec; no PDK / SDC / floorplan constraints at the protocol layer. Per-controller integration constraints (clock-tree budget, transceiver pad ring, common-mode rejection at the PHY) live in the SoC integration spec, not in Bosch CAN 2.0.

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
